slices.focus: Saira creates a monthly dashboard for Peter tracking queue times, labeling slips, and repeat-bag corrections
slices.summary: Saira formalizes her wall notes into a monthly one-page dashboard for Peter tracking queue times, labeling slips, and repeat-bag corrections. Autumn numbers show the busiest weekday queues are faster than the previous year. She plans a fixed monthly send date with three-line summary and minimal context notes.
open_loops: Fixed monthly send date not yet established
Dashboard needs a boundary rule to prevent scope creep
Protecting routines from drift is ongoing priority
Staff need to hear that corrections numbers are protective, not punitive
decisions: Saira remained operations lead and turned her wall notes into a simple monthly dashboard tracking queue times, labeling
